labels.reason: All supplied source units were reviewed. Eight digitized mean plasma concentration-time points, point identifiers and original figure coordinates support candidate mouse systemic PK input availability. DR001 has source-backed drug and source-role evidence. DR002, DR003, DR006, DR007 and DR013 have partial input coverage: the source identifies the figure, dose, formulation wording, route, matrix and infection state, but does not establish individual trajectories, biological variability, total/free concentration basis, study-specific body weight, requested model outputs or translation compatibility. DR020 has panel/curve identity and a single-dose PK input, but no strain-MIC-response mapping. DR039 has group-summary and sample-count context only; it supplies no defensible individual PK variability estimate. Requirement links represent partial evidence, not completed requirements or scientific acceptance. MI001 remains AMBIGUOUS and OPEN; MI019 remains DEFERRED and OPEN.

findings.reason: F0003:S1:T32:A639-A641 explicitly describes digitized observed means and reports 3 or 4 mice/time without recovered point-specific n or numerical SD. Point labels do not identify experimental animals. Serial versus destructive sampling, missingness and BLQ/LLOQ information are NOT_FOUND on this page; this does not establish their absence.
findings.needed_material: Preserve source and point identifiers, calibrated times and figure coordinates. Obtain available sampling-design, point-specific sample-count, biological-variability and censoring metadata without reconstructing individual records.

findings.reason: The page supports SC dosing, plasma, mg/L concentrations, a 32 mg/kg dose and the wording as-reported PMB sulphate. Total versus unbound concentration basis and any salt-to-active-moiety conversion definition are NOT_FOUND. The calibrated time column does not explicitly define its time origin.
findings.needed_material: Confirm concentration basis, dose/analyte convention and time origin before affected comparisons or links. Retain the reported units and formulation wording without conversion; document any subsequently proposed bridge separately.

findings.reason: The item supplies a mouse plasma curve under a single SC dose, supporting candidate systemic input coverage. Requested model outputs, study-supported held-out prediction opportunities and pulmonary observations are NOT_FOUND on this page. Input availability does not establish fit, identifiability or prediction.
findings.needed_material: Retain the mouse systemic curve as a candidate and obtain the intended curve/parameter outputs and study-design context in the animal PK module.

findings.reason: Digitized mean concentrations, calibrated sampling times, a dose, route, figure identity and extraction coordinates are available. The stated +/-2-pixel sensitivity is not biological SD.
findings.needed_material: Resolve applicable dosing-time and sampling definitions and retrieve available design and biological-variability metadata. Preserve digitization provenance and distinguish reconstruction sensitivity from animal variability. Leave model-dependent adequacy to the animal PK module.

findings.reason: This page supplies a candidate mouse plasma curve and explicitly identifies neutropenic thigh infection. A single mouse curve does not establish qualified cross-species coverage.
findings.needed_material: Reuse this candidate curve with its source and infection state. Obtain actual study-specific body weight if the considered translation approach requires size scaling, and assess parameter/curve compatibility before translation.

findings.needed_material: Verify the panel, regimen, strain-MIC and response associations required by SC032, documenting supported matches and unresolved links. Escalate the unresolved mapping at preparation before treating panels as matched regimen-level exposure-response records.

findings.reason: MI019 remains DEFERRED, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at clinical.
